```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Extract the tab-separated county files into a temporary directory
files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())

# Read all county files; X2 is county, X12 is office, X15 is candidate, X16 is party, X19 is votes
raw_results <- read_tsv(files, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE, quote = "")

# Calculate Angie Nixon's share of the Democratic Senate vote in each county
sen_dem_county <- raw_results |>
  filter(X12 == "United States Senator", X16 == "DEM") |>
  summarize(votes = sum(as.numeric(X19), na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(X2, X15)) |>
  mutate(county_key = str_to_lower(X2)) |>
   summarize(
    nixon_share = sum(votes[X15 == "Angie Nixon"]) / sum(votes),
    .by = county_key
  )

# Load Florida county shapes and join by lowercase county name (fixes "Desoto" vs "DeSoto")
fl_counties <- counties("FL", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  mutate(county_key = str_to_lower(NAME)) |>
  left_join(sen_dem_county, by = "county_key")

# Map county-level vote share with a diverging scale centered at 50%
fl_counties |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = nixon_share)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d95f02",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#1b9e77",
    midpoint = 0.5,
    labels = label_percent(),
    name = "Angie Nixon\nVote Share"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Democratic Primary for U.S. Senate",
    subtitle = "County vote share: Angie Nixon (green) vs. Alex Vindman (orange)",
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
